subject: ENGLISH
title: Be-Verb Team · M01 D11
objective: Choose am, is, are, was, or were to agree with the subject and time.
introduction: Milo says, "I am ready!" Can you say it right too? Pick am, is, are, was, or were to match the subject and the time.

vocabulary.definition: An action or being word; am, is, are, was, and were are be-verbs.
The part of a sentence that tells who or what.
The time that has already happened.

activities.instruction: Meet the be-verb team: am, is, are, was, were!
activities.content: Use I am; he, she, or it is; you, we, or they are. For past time use was or were with the matching subject.

feedback.retry: Find the clue in Be-Verb Team again. 💪

activities.accessibilityAlternative: Text alternative: Use I am; he, she, or it is; you, we, or they are. For past time use was or were with the matching subject.

activities.instruction: Tap each sentence and say the be-verb out loud.

feedback.correct: Great! You found the examples for Be-Verb Team. 🔎
feedback.retry: Look at each Be-Verb Team example again. 💪

activities.accessibilityAlternative: A numbered list of the same examples is available for keyboard and screen-reader use.

activities.instruction: Sort each card: does the verb agree with the subject?

feedback.correct: Great! You sorted the examples using the Be-Verb Team clue. 🎉
feedback.retry: Use the explanation, not color or position.

activities.accessibilityAlternative: Tap an item and then tap a labeled category; dragging is optional.

activities.instruction: Pick the sentence that uses the be-verb right.

feedback.retry: They goes with are, not is or am. Pick the pair that sounds right: They are helpful. 💪

activities.accessibilityAlternative: All choices are visible text and selectable with TalkBack.

activities.instruction: Match each sentence to its be-verb.

feedback.correct: Great! You matched each example with its Be-Verb Team explanation. 🔗
feedback.retry: Read both sides of each Be-Verb Team pair again. 💪

activities.accessibilityAlternative: A list-based matching control replaces drag gestures.

activities.instruction: Put the be-verb steps in order.

steps: Check the time of the sentence.
Choose am, is, are, was, or were.

feedback.correct: Great! You put the Be-Verb Team steps in order. 🎉
feedback.retry: Find the first, next, and last Be-Verb Team steps. 💪

activities.accessibilityAlternative: Up and down buttons provide an alternative to dragging.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the be-verb correctly?
items.explanation: They goes with are: you, we, and they take are. “They am reading” and “I is ready” mix the wrong pairs.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses am, is, or are correctly?
items.explanation: I takes am, so “I am ready” is right. “I is ready” and “They am reading” pair the wrong words.
“I is ready” is wrong because I takes am. “I am ready” and “They are reading” match their subjects.
They takes are, so “They are helpful” is right. “They am” and “They is” are wrong pairs.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the verb correctly?
items.explanation: “She was here yesterday” is right because she takes was for the past. “We was here” and “I is ready” mix the wrong pairs.
